'''''Tatium''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] assigned to the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']]. [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]] used it to flee the Star Destroyer before its self-destruction.
